Report DescriptionREMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE ANOMALY APPEARED TO EMANATE FROM THE DESTROYED TAYLOR PLATFORM, A KNOWN REPEAT LEAK SOURCE, AND WAS APPROXIMATELY 11.2 NMI IN LENGTH AND UP TO 0.47 NMI IN WIDTH IN TWO DISTINCT PARTS. IT WIDENED APPRECIABLY WITH DISTANCE FROM THE SUSPECTED SOURCE, DISPLAYED SHARP EDGES, AND WAS DISTINCT FROM ITS BACKGROUND. SAR-DERIVED WINDS AND NEARBY SURFACE WIND OBSERVATIONS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE AROUND 5 KTS FROM THE WSW, WHICH ALIGNED WITH THE ORIENTATION OF THE ANOMALY. UNCERTAINTIES: A FALSE POSITIVE JUST TO THE NORTH OF THE IMAGE WAS UNRELATED TO THE ANOMALY. OTHERWISE, GIVEN THE REPEAT LEAK NATURE OF THE SUSPECTED SOURCE, THERE ARE NO UNCERTAINTIES.

THE THREE TRANSFORMERS FELL ONTO THE TOP OF THE SEMI'S TRAILER, AND WERE DAMAGED, RELEASING BETWEEN 30 TO 60 GALLONS OF NON-PCB MINERAL OIL. THE EVENT OCCURRED DURING A THUNDERSTORM, AND THE RELEASED OIL ENTERED ROAD SIDE DITCH LINES, AND DOWN GRADIENT STORM DRAINS.

THE PIER SECTIONS ARE STACKED NEXT TO THE FURNACE AND MY PARENTS WITNESSED THEM PUTTING THESE SECTIONS INTO THE FURNACE. THIS COMPANY REMOVES LARGE OLD PIERS (6" X 6" TIMBERS) AND BUILDS NEW PIERS FOR THE SURROUNDING LAKES SO THE POTENTIAL RANGE OF CHEMICALS BEING BURNED AND RELEASED MAY BE BROAD (CHLORINE, ARSENIC, LEAD, MERCURY, DIOXINS ETC). properties.content:
Report Details

Nearest City: St Johns, AZ
Location: CORONADO GENERATING STATION - UNIT 1 ABSORBER BUILDING HWY 191 7 MILES N OF ST. JOHNS
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: HYDROGEN SULFIDE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: SALT RIVER PROJECT
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 34.579167, -109.272778 (Explicit)
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** THERE WAS A RELEASE OF HYDROGEN SULFIDE IN COMBINATION WITH CARBON DISULFIDE DUE TO THE INADVERTENT MIXING OF TWO CHEMICALS IN A STORAGE TANK. A STORAGE TANK WITH CONTAINS SODIUM TRITHIOCARBONATE WAS INADVERTENTLY FILLED FROM A TRUCK CONTAINING A PHOSPHONIC ACID SALT SOLUTION WHICH WAS INTENDED FOR A DIFFERENT STORAGE TANK. A CHEMICAL REACTION RESULTED FROM THE MIXTURE OF THE TWO CHEMICALS. THIS CHEMICAL REACTION HAS THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE HYDROGEN SULFIDE AND CARBON DISULFIDE DEPENDING ON THE PH OF THE RESULTING SOLUTION. HYDROGEN SULFIDE WAS DETECTED IN THE AREA AND INSIDE THE STORAGE TANK. THE AMOUNT OF THE RELEASE IS NOT ABLE TO BE QUANTIFIED AT THIS TIME BUT MAY BE GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO THE RQ AMOUNT FOR HYDROGEN SULFIDE AND/OR CARBON DISULFIDE.

Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** ON 06MAY2013, BETWEEN THE HOURS OF 0000-0700 (APPROX.), CGC TAMPA ACCIDENTALLY DISCHARGED 31 GALLONS OF UNLEADED GASOLINE FROM A STORAGE DRUM LOCATED ON THE FANTAIL. REASON FOR DISCHARGE WAS A FAULTY VALVE ON THE STORAGE DRUM. THE CLOSEST POINT OF LAND DURING THAT TIME PERIOD WAS BEACH HAVEN, NEW JERSEY, 52 NM WEST. BOTH WIND AND SEA DIRECTION VARIED BETWEEN 054 DEG TO 072 DEG TRUE, IN A DIRECTION AWAY FROM THE CLOSEST POINT OF LAND. SEA STATE WAS 1 FT, WITH SWELLS AT 4 FT. CGC TAMPA'S SPEED OF ADVANCE WAS 6-7 KTS OVER THE SAME TIME PERIOD. NO PERSONNEL WITNESSED THE SPILL. THE LAST PERSON WAS ON THE FANTAIL AT APPROX. 0000 06MAY13 AND THE SPILL WAS DISCOVERED AT 0700 06MAY13. NO SPILL CONTAINMENT EFFORTS WERE UNDERTAKEN, AS NO VISIBLE SHEEN WAS WITNESSED.
